title: Customer bulk actions act only on visible selected rows
interface: Review finding M1. CustomersTable now stays mounted when the filtered list is empty (it renders an emptyState prop), so selectedRows survives filter changes: select a row, filter it out, and the bulk bar still says 1 selected and Delete/Export act on the hidden id. Fix: derive visibleSelected = selectedRows filtered to ids present in the customers prop currently rendered (all filtered rows, not just the current page, matching how select-all and bulk actions worked before), and use visibleSelected everywhere the selection drives UI or actions: the bulk bar visibility and count, Delete (setDeleteIds), Export, and the select-all checkbox state (checked/indeterminate). Also prune selectedRows to visible ids when the customers list changes (a useEffect on the list identity is fine) so hidden ids never come back. Row checkboxes keep working. Do not change copy or other behaviour. title: Small layout fixes: header actions wrap, contacts search, customer avatar fallback, latest leads footer
interface: Four small fixes. (1) PageHeader.tsx: the actions row (children) is flex items-center gap-2 and cannot wrap, so a w-48 search plus a button overflows under 360px; add flex-wrap to that row. (2) contacts/client.tsx: the header search wrapper w-48 gets max-sm:w-full. (3) customers/[id]/client.tsx: the header avatar is an img with src customer.avatar_url || '/images/avatars/default.svg', but that file does not exist, so a broken image and its alt text spill out of the 36px tile. Replace it with the Avatar component from @/components/ui (the one leads/[id]/client.tsx uses for its header: check its import and props there), passing the avatar_url when present and the customer name for initials, sized to fit the 36px tile. (4) LatestLeads.tsx: the overview always passes the same 6 latest leads, but the footer paginates over the org's total lead count, so pages 2..n show the same rows. Remove the pagination: drop TableFooter and the page state, render all passed leads, and show a footer line in the TableFooter style (flex h-12 items-center px-8 max-sm:px-4 text-[13px] text-fg-muted) reading Showing {leads.length} of {totalLeads} leads, only when leads.length > 0. Keep props the same so the overview compiles unchanged. title: Settings ignores unknown tab values
interface: Review finding L2. settings/client.tsx casts searchParams.get('tab') to SettingsTab without checking it, so ?tab=foo renders Profile while no sidebar item or mobile tab is highlighted. Add to components/layout/settings-nav.ts an exported helper parseSettingsTab(value: string | null): SettingsTab that returns the value when it is one of the ids in SETTINGS_GROUPS and 'profile' otherwise. Use it in settings/client.tsx for the active tab and in Sidebar.tsx for the settings nav active item, so both always agree. No other changes. title: Row menu accessibility and scroll behaviour
interface: Review finding L4 on the portalled ActionMenu. (1) The trigger button gets aria-label (use an optional label prop defaulting to 'More actions'), aria-haspopup='menu' and aria-expanded={open}; the menu container gets role='menu' and items role='menuitem' if they do not already. (2) Shift+Tab from the open trigger (focus leaving backwards) closes the menu. (3) While open, the fixed menu follows its trigger when the page scrolls and can end up over the top bar: instead of repositioning on scroll, close the menu on scroll events that do not originate inside the menu (keep repositioning on resize). Keep portal, outside-click, Escape and focus-return behaviour and all item rendering.
